mapper.select: SELECT fail_cnt_limit, fail_cnt_denied_ti, pw_expire_cnt, session_expire_cnt, del_log_cnt, acc_ip_yn, title, menu_version, (SELECT r.file_id FROM r_file r JOIN t_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = 1 AND r.file_loc = 'LOGO' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS logo_file_id FROM t_config LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_config SET fail_cnt_limit = NULLIF(#{failCntLimit}, '')::integer, fail_cnt_denied_ti = NULLIF(#{failCntDeniedTi}, '')::integer, pw_expire_cnt = NULLIF(#{pwExpireCnt}, '')::integer, session_expire_cnt = NULLIF(#{sessionExpireCnt}, '')::integer, del_log_cnt = NULLIF(#{delLogCnt}, '')::integer, acc_ip_yn = #{accIpYn}, title = #{title}
